# The XPConnect address adapter returns an array despite its singular JSDoc

The same landing changes fixXpconnectAddresses to test !addr.group and adds JSDoc. Its fixed implementation returns addrs.map(...), but @returns still names one msgIAddressObject instead of an array; the makeMimeHeader caller hands that array to emitter.addAddresses. A focused documentation correction should name the array return and check the input type spelling. This is a verified local comment/type mismatch, not a runtime result or a global comment template. Exact unavailable discussion keeps this public source-only knowledge at zero full-audit credit. No runtime or test ran.

Scope: Mailbox parser, XPConnect array and documentation contracts.
